title: Test plan · Week 1 · v1
sub: 3 tests, $182 test budget for the week
headline: Two build-on winners and one replace-loser test to address the Day 7 readout while staying honest to the real product.

content.summary: Two build-on winners and one replace-loser test to address the Day 7 readout while staying honest to the real product.

tests.name: Walk-Test Graduate - Gentle Steering Harness
tests.hypothesis: If we graduate the winning walk-test video approach into Evergreen, a harness creative about front-clip steering + padding will beat the cost target.
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost_per_result above 1.2 times target after 2x target spend; graduate if cost_per_result at or below target and results reach 30.

brief.hook: Clip in front for guided strolls, cushioned for happy wiggle-butts
brief.key_message: Shows the real dog harness and how its front chest clip helps guide walks while full-body padding keeps it comfortable.

tests.name: Fountain Reset - Clean in a Snap
tests.hypothesis: Replacing the Quiet-pump angle that lost will improve cost if we lead with easy cleaning instead.
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost_per_result above 1.2 times target after 2x target spend; keep if cost_per_result at or below target.

brief.hook: Toss the ceramic top in the dishwasher and done
brief.key_message: Shows the real ceramic cat water fountain and its detachable, smooth ceramic parts that make cleanup quick.

tests.name: Retarget Harness - No Wrestling Quick Buckle
tests.hypothesis: For shoppers who viewed or carted, a harness creative about no over-the-head hassle will lift purchases among warm traffic.
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost_per_result above 1.2 times target after 2x target spend; keep if cost_per_result at or below target.

brief.hook: No over-the-head wrestling — buckle, adjust, go
brief.key_message: Shows the real dog harness and its quick-release buckles and adjustable straps for a snug, easy-on fit.
